title: Directions EMEA 2026 - Paris, the Consultant Zone, and Two Panels
summary: The post announces the author's participation in Directions EMEA 2026 conference in Paris, including involvement with the Consultant Zone and two panel discussions about AI prompts for Business Central work and the evolving boundary between consultant and developer roles in AL development.
key_points: Directions EMEA 2026 takes place in Paris from October 27-29 at Palais des Congrès
The Consultant Zone targets functional consultants and implementers who work directly with Business Central in real-world scenarios
First panel covers practical AI prompts used in actual Business Central work and why ineffective prompts fail
Second panel explores when consultants should write AL code given AI assistance has lowered barriers to entry and changed consultant-developer boundaries
Discussion emphasizes governance and ownership of code as AI tools expand consultant technical capabilities

quotes.text: No theory, no AI hype deck, just prompts that genuinely earn their place in a working day.
quotes.why_it_matters: Emphasizes practical, actionable AI prompt guidance rather than theoretical concepts for Business Central consultants

quotes.text: The boundary between consultant and developer has always been drawn somewhere around who opens VS Code, and AI assistance has moved that line.
quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies how AI is changing traditional role definitions and creating new questions about when consultants should code
